accepted.rule: A time series buckets the time column and aliases it; timeField names the alias
accepted.sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, count(*) AS requests FROM http_requests GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

accepted.rule: A scalar has no time column at all
accepted.sql: SELECT count(*) AS requests FROM http_requests
SELECT route, count(*) AS requests FROM metrics.http_requests GROUP BY route

accepted.rule: CTEs, joins, FILTER, window functions and percentile aggregates are fine
accepted.sql: WITH per_route AS (SELECT route, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status >= 500) AS errors FROM http_requests GROUP BY route) SELECT route, n, errors, rank() OVER (ORDER BY n DESC) AS rnk FROM per_route

accepted.rule: Only exposed columns may be named
accepted.sql: SELECT service, avg(duration_ms) AS avg_ms FROM http_requests GROUP BY service

accepted.rule: A declared variable is referenced as :name, unquoted
accepted.sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, avg(cpu_pct) AS cpu FROM host_metrics WHERE host = :host GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

accepted.rule: A multi-value variable is bound as an array
accepted.sql: SELECT host, max(cpu_pct) AS peak FROM host_metrics WHERE host = ANY(:host) GROUP BY host

accepted.rule: Fixed intervals in the query are fine; only clock readings are refused
accepted.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '5 minutes', ts) AS bucket, avg(cpu_pct) AS cpu FROM host_metrics GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

rejected.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM http_requests -- all of them

rejected.rule: No time filter: the server owns the window
rejected.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM http_requests WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM http_requests WHERE ts > current_timestamp - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM http_requests WHERE ts > 'now'::timestamptz
SELECT route FROM http_requests ORDER BY random() LIMIT 5

rejected.rule: No server-side sleeps, file access or session state
Only tables in the source's catalog
Not even a catalog table under another schema

rejected.sql: SELECT client_ip, count(*) AS n FROM http_requests GROUP BY client_ip

rejected.rule: No SELECT * over a table with an unexposed column
rejected.error: SELECT * is not allowed on http_requests: it has unexposed columns

rejected.rule: A variable must be declared on the dashboard
rejected.sql: SELECT avg(cpu_pct) AS cpu FROM host_metrics WHERE host = :host

rejected.rule: Query parameters ($1) are reserved for the server
rejected.sql: SELECT avg(cpu_pct) AS cpu FROM host_metrics WHERE host = $1
SELECT route INTO copy_of_routes FROM http_requests
SELECT route FROM http_requests FOR UPDATE
rejected.error: row locking (FOR UPDATE / FOR SHARE) is not allowed
